sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: For travelers, Cảm ơn, tôi hiểu rồi is the phrase to keep ready for "Thanks, I understand now" in finding places, turns, distance, and walking directions. This is for when the directions finally make sense and you are ready to move. This is useful when the other person kept helping and you want to end the exchange cleanly. It works best when you focus on making the next practical step easy for the other person to choose. After you say it, listen for a clear reply, a pointed detail, or a simple follow-up; the next rows help you keep the exchange moving.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Use Cảm ơn, tôi hiểu rồi as your first sentence for "Thanks, I understand now". This is for when the directions finally make sense and you are ready to move. Keep the map, address, or destination visible while you speak so the reply points to the same place.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: If the answer is long, ask them to point or type it. Street directions can be hard to catch by ear.

sections.title: Local tip
sections.body: Show the map or address first, then ask the phrase. The answer is easier to understand when both of you see the same place.
